mission: Mission 5 (#274) follow-up, OP-18 JP release date (CEO option 1 approved 2026-11-11 21:37; continues as its own DATA step, CEO 2026-11-13 22:49). The OP-18 release product (bandai_jp, release_product_id 290 on staging) was created by catalogue-import apply run 43434421865 without a date, so the website shows released_on null. Data migration cb7419af37e9 on 001d92ba8eb9 sets released_on 2026-11-21 and release_date_source DATE_VERIFIED_SINGLE_SOURCE on that one product only when it is still undated, in the same style as c4e9a2b7816d (catalogue plus official code match; no insert or delete). Frozen input docs/evidence/op18-release-date-2026-11-12.json: Bandai JP product page read 2026-11-12, 2026-11-13 and 2026-11-14, each 2026年11月21日(土). apply_migration.py allowlists cb7419af37e9 on 001d92ba8eb9. Order after merge: owner approves apply-migration dry run, then the apply; then a fleet PR records revision cb7419af37e9.

impacts.reason: Data-only migration: updates at most one release_products row (bandai_jp OP-18, released_on null) to 2026-11-21 with source DATE_VERIFIED_SINGLE_SOURCE; downgrade clears only that exact value. No schema change. Applied after merge only by the owner-approved apply-migration runbook.
apply-migration allowlist gains the pair cb7419af37e9 on 001d92ba8eb9. No secret, gate, permission or timeout change.
Allowlist pair; upgrade dates only the undated OP-18 product, leaves dated or other products alone, downgrade reverts only its own value (Postgres test runs in CI).

routes: /cards?release_product_id=290 and the release list read released_on; no source route
dependencies: staging 2d541710 or later; no open PR must merge first
then apply-migration cb7419af37e9 dry run and apply (owner), then fleet revision PR
impact.deployment_impact: API, market-index-snapshot and official-images-mirror rebuild from Git (API image). No collector release, no collector pin or evidence refresh. Until apply-migration runs, staging stays on revision 001d92ba8eb9 and OP-18 stays undated, as today.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR with its own mission file before apply; after apply, Alembic downgrade to 001d92ba8eb9 clears only this value (separate owner decision).
recovery.trigger: Bandai changes the JP date before release, or the apply dry run shows any row other than OP-18 changing.
recovery.backup: Railway Postgres backup under 24 h (required by apply-migration).

verification.observation_window: apply-migration dry run and apply runs; then /cards?release_product_id=290 shows released_on 2026-11-21 and chronology_available true.
